structured_output.world_model:
W2 (empirical), after E035. Tip is E035: 5.446 s, 0.7548 on seeds 0-2. It is E034 (freeze of group 1 and whitening bias at 75%, 9.25 epochs, 231 steps, batch 2000, 20/24/28/32 px at 15/25/30/30%, wd x0.5) plus a bit-identical prepare cleanup. The cleanup saved 0.035 s with unchanged accuracy, as my forecast said. Held-out margin is unknown; the E027 base sat near 0.7526, so the true margin over 0.753 is about zero.

Mechanisms, each tied to measured runs:
1. Epoch dial: about 5% of time per 0.5 epoch for 0.0-0.2 pp (E020, E023, E027). E034 shows freeze plus 0.5 epoch gives -0.40 s vs E027 at +0.0 pp on seeds 0-2.
2. EMA (+0.97 pp, E005) and Muon (+0.66 pp, E006, confounded) are in the tip. Averaging and optimizer settings look tuned. A harder pull (E025), a longer interval (E030) and late LS=0 (E032) all hurt. wd, LS, Muon lr, LR floor and warm-up are flat within noise. Time-neutral boosters have failed 5 times in a row.
3. Time tracks pixels and FLOPs, sublinearly on small maps. Early low-res is nearly free (E026, E033). The 28 and 32 px phases carry the accuracy (E018, E024).
4. Backward truncation is the best lever found (E028 -0.5 s, then E034). Group-1 maps are memory-bound. Selecting examples (E031) is worse.
5. Noise: identical code is bit-identical. Any change to step count or RNG use reshuffles the 3-seed mean by about ±0.2 pp. Held-out runs about 0.2 pp below seeds 0-2. Time noise is about 0.5%.

Misses: I overpredicted time on trims and freezes (savings run 2-8% larger than modelled). I was too optimistic on time-neutral accuracy changes.

Unsure: E035's held-out margin; the bar may be at risk. Remaining stem levers (whitening-bias stop, earlier freeze) should save time at the epoch-dial rate in accuracy. Muon-to-SGD swap has an unclear accuracy cost, and its time gain is small.

forecasts.reason: Whitening bias LR is already 0 after 3 epochs (~1/3 of steps), so the idea is a modest change: stopping at 20% skips whitening backward for steps 20-33% only, while the freeze already covers the last 25%. Small saving.
A 10% longer freeze saves about 0.15 s, with accuracy loss near the epoch-dial rate on seeds 0-2.
Diagnostic with no recipe change. Fresh-seed mean is likely about 0.752-0.753, with a winner's curse.
Folding BN in the frozen stem removes memory-bound passes, saving about 0.15 s. Complexity and a stats mismatch carry some accuracy risk.
Profiling diagnostic. It likely confirms that non-GEMM kernels are a large share, in line with E028.
Dropping Muon likely costs a few tenths of a pp and saves about 1-2% in time.

cruxes: Is the held-out (seeds 3-12 or 13-22) mean of the current tip at or above 0.753? If not, the next time cut needs an accuracy booster first.
Does the whitening-bias LR already hit 0 after 3 epochs in the code? If so, H2.6.3 is mostly settled and I054 saves little.
What share of a 32 px step is memory-bound BN/GELU in group 1 under the frozen phase? It sets the value of I057 and I055.
